purpose: Pinned operational knowledge injected into every CURSOR_PROMPT. Not constitution. Company form still wins on stack.

entries.title: Director / orchestrator / specialists
entries.text: Human Director decides scope and HITL. EOS/Agent orchestrates. Subagents/skills specialize with clean context. Program WITH AI; do not surrender direction.

entries.title: SDD DAG before code
entries.text: proposal → (specs ∥ design) → tasks → apply → verify → archive. Implementation is not the first meaningful act. Missing dependency → STOP.

entries.title: Phase gatekeeper
entries.text: Each phase returns a fixed contract; claimed artifacts must exist before advancing. No 'mostly done' as done.

entries.title: Specs + TDD
entries.text: Acceptance criteria / PROJECT_SPECS before implementation. Prefer RED then GREEN when the repo has a test harness.

entries.title: Trust = re-derivation
entries.text: Code without persistent justification is legacy at machine speed. Trace lines to specs/artifacts. Never invent VERIFIED or PRODUCTION_READY.

entries.title: Agile is delivery, not ceremony
entries.text: Dailies/sprints alone are not agility. Ship small slices, accept change, share knowledge.

entries.title: Architecture when applicable
entries.text: Prefer clear module boundaries (ports/adapters inspire). Scope Rule / screaming features only when the project's front stack allows — never impose React/Tailwind/Claude runtime.

entries.title: Evidence over claims
entries.text: Command or receipt before MEASURED/VERIFIED. Protected surfaces Δ=0. Lessons append-only; constitution immutable via learning.
